subtitle: Tier 5 Final — 8 cumulative questions covering lessons 40-44. Pass with 7/8 to unlock Tier 6 (Execution & Journaling).

blocks.title: About this final
blocks.content:
Tier 5 covered the macro and contextual layer — how DXY/VIX/ES affect crypto, BTC dominance and alt season, Fear & Greed contrarian framework, news events, correlation regimes. Smaller tier (5 lessons) so the final is 8 questions.

Pass threshold: 7/8 required.

rows: DXY (inverse), VIX (inverse spikes), ES (lead indicator), 10Y yield. Risk-on vs risk-off regime defines crypto tailwind/headwind.
Falling BTC.D = alt rotation; rising = capital fleeing alts to BTC. Trade WITH the rotation.
Extreme Fear (under 25) = look for longs. Extreme Greed (over 75) = look for shorts/take profits. Combine with technical confirmation.
FOMC/CPI/NFP move crypto 3-7%. Flatten before or trade post-event. Don't predict direction.
Crypto-equity correlation varies. High correlation = macro leads; decoupled = crypto narratives dominate.

blocks.content: If you pass at 7/8, Tier 6 (Execution & Journaling) unlocks — Trade Apgar pre-trade scorecard, pre-session readiness, journaling, trade review, building your own system, then the capstone.
